title: Length of a joined record template
statement: Let $Q$ and $T$ be types, and let $n$ and $s$ be natural numbers. Form a record template from the binary digits of $n+1$ in a field of width equal to the number of binary digits of $n+1$, followed by $2s+1$ work-cell symbols; join the two fields by inserting one separator. The resulting list has length equal to that width plus $2s+2$.
